description: This file defines internal structures, functions, and classes for handling civil time representations, including normalization, arithmetic, and comparison of date/time fields, within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: civil_time
classes.description: Template class representing civil date/time with various alignments (year, month, day, hour, minute, second). Provides arithmetic, comparison, and accessors.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds a difference in seconds to a civil_time object.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts a difference in seconds or another civil_time object to compute difference.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two civil_time objects.
